bio.text: Steve Cohen is the Republican candidate for California's 50th Congressional District in 2026, challenging incumbent Scott Peters.
He was news director of San Diego's KUSI-TV for 20 years until its 2023 sale to Nexstar Media Group, in a television news career spanning about 50 years.
He previously managed newsrooms in New York, Detroit, Philadelphia and Los Angeles, and his first news director job was in Peoria, Illinois, in 1973.

sources.title: MarketInk: After 50 years of covering politicians, ex-KUSI news director Steve Cohen is running for Congress
